name: LocalStack CLI (lstk)
description: Installs lstk, the LocalStack CLI. lstk starts and manages LocalStack and runs the AWS CLI, Terraform, AWS CDK and AWS SAM against it.

version.description: Select or enter an lstk version (see https://github.com/localstack/lstk/releases).

pulumilocal.description: Install pulumi-local (pulumilocal), the LocalStack wrapper for Pulumi. lstk has no Pulumi command. Installs pipx and Python.
